digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git maintenance and bridge-state history reclaim
propositions: Spent ~1 GiB of unreachable ticket-event objects must be reclaimed from the tickets-store git history using length-aware history stripping (fast-export filter import) rather than repack/gc alone.
The filtered tickets-store pack size must be reduced below the 131072 KiB CI gate limit to prevent stale-base changes from failing the pack-size verification step.
Bug 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a must be executed and closed with zero repairable diagnostics before the history rewrite to ensure the authoritative store is clean.

The bridge-state history must be rewritten using a scratch output ref with dynamic re-addition of current .bridge_state/ tree, followed by separate operator-controlled repack/gc, with verified off-repo backup bundles created before and after all mutations.

All pre-rewrite and post-rewrite invariants (tree equality, commit/merge counts, size limits, identity multiset equivalence, old-tip non-ancestry, and infrastructure convergence) must be verified before and after force-with-lease publication.

The deterministic first post-rewrite write must occur with REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN disabled as a single canonical four-commit review-bot vote sequence, with growth below 1 MB and old-tip ancestry remaining false.
